validity_policy.invalidate_when: reference minimap mask alignment fails persistently or known map geometry changes
validity_policy.on_invalidate: calibration_required; do not resolve named zones

coordinate_system.definition: Public Bind reference texture visible floor bounding box; x/y normalized to this bbox, never ROI or world meters.
coordinate_system.orientation: fixed public texture orientation: defender spawn above, A on right, B on left
coordinate_system.calibration_note: The 1024x1024 public asset is an authoring canvas, not a 1920x1080 HUD ROI. Runtime uses explicit actual ROI and whole-outline calibration.

minimap_runtime_profile.zoom_or_hud_scale_change_behavior: recalibrate static mask; if stable alignment cannot be recovered -> calibration_required

authoring_limits: Only visible A/B shaded plant footprints are mapped; this is not full Site callout geometry.
Every other position is zone UNKNOWN; no invented corridor, spawn or detailed callout boundary.
Topology has no edges because no complete connecting zones have been authored.
Visible-floor raster preserves 2D texture support; it does not establish 3D walkability or line of sight.
Operational QA mask covers only an independently eroded A plant core; not whole-map zone coverage.
Published asset version unknown; recording build is checked privately and runtime alignment is mandatory.
